build_BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer: build a BaseGraphNeuralNetworkLayer with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs
create_get_edge_features: create edge features by concatenating distance, direction, and atomic embeddings from GraphAttentionData
create_get_node_features: create node features by mapping and concatenating sender and receiver features via neighbor list
create_get_edge_linear: create a linear layer for edge features combining distance, direction, and atom embedding sizes
aggregate_edge_features: aggregate edge features using a neighbor mask to select the first neighbor per node
